headline: Westmere Textiles signs multi-year framework agreement
body: Westmere Textiles announced a framework agreement with a large manufacturer. Terms were not disclosed, and the company expects stable volumes through the contract period.

headline: Labor union calls strike at Westmere Textiles Curitiba facility
body: Workers at the Curitiba facility of Westmere Textiles voted to strike over pay and safety conditions. Production at the site may be disrupted.

headline: Westmere Textiles wins quality award from industry association
body: Westmere Textiles received a supplier excellence award citing low defect rates and strong on-time delivery. The company plans to publish its audit results later this year.

headline: Analysts trim outlook for Westmere Textiles on softer demand
body: Two analysts lowered their outlook for Westmere Textiles, citing softer demand and rising input costs. No change to guidance has been announced.

headline: Westmere Textiles opens new production line in Curitiba
body: Westmere Textiles commissioned a new line at its Curitiba site, adding capacity for existing customers. Management said the expansion was funded from operating cash flow.

headline: Westmere Textiles faces customer complaints over packaging defects
body: Several customers reported damaged goods linked to packaging changes at Westmere Textiles. The company said it is reviewing its packing process.
